prediction: #474, the Thor check. The first cut read 4636.591 ns here (1-1790540677-flip474-2313275): its counter advanced 1.2 ms over a 110 ms span with a 100 ms sleep in it. The Thor's SoC and driver are the Nova's, so the guess is the same 52.083 ns counter. The route need not play: both Thor runs of the first cut were refused input focus, and every leg here is read off the start-up line or off whatever the title draws unattended.

legs.K0 (the line): exactly one 'init: GPU timestamp period reported= measured= (+-%, span, samples k of n, halves differ %) using= (measured|reported[; not measured: why])' in the logcat. KILL: none.
legs.K1 (the value, a guess): measured= is 52.08 ns +-1% and using= is the measured value. KILL: using= is a measured value outside 49.5 to 54.7 ns; the first cut's 4636 would be that.
legs.K3 (the self-check, a guess): as on the Nova, confidence 70%. If the line says '(reported; not measured: ...)', the Thor's counter depends on idle gaps of 300 us; that is the finding and using= is 33.11.
legs.G2 (physically possible): every hakuX-phase line has GPU <= 1.05 x Tot. The first cut read GPU 28 to 30 ms of a 32.5 ms frame on a two-pass screen that reads 0.2 ms with the reported period.
legs.G3 (the screen the first cut got wrong): on the unattended screen (RP:2), GPU is under 1 ms. KILL: over 5 ms.
